headlines.text: 2021 brought us this moment: Minoru Suzuki announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance against Jon Moxley, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.18.
It was 2023 when Samoa Joe vs. Jeff Hardy met in a Tournament Match, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 6.42.
Rewind to 2021, when it marked the first-ever meeting between Malakai Black and Dustin Rhodes, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 5.73.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2023, when Penta El Zero M vs. Jay Lethal met for the very first time, kicking off the show on Rampage, rated 6.35.
Flash back to 2023, when it was the first-ever encounter between The Young Bucks and 2.O on Rampage, rated 5.97.
On a Wednesday in 2021, back when Ruby Soho vs. Jamie Hayter met for the very first time on Dynamite, rated 4.63.
